Knowledge

The central commercial roofing reference library: evidence-based educational articles, practical decision guides, and technical resources — written so commercial property owners and decision-makers can make informed roofing decisions.

Every page in this library is written for the person carrying the decision, not the person selling the roof. Published work is editorially reviewed and lists its sources; each page carries its own publication status and review date, so you always know how mature the guidance is. The library grows only as new work clears editorial review — looking for something specific? Search the knowledge base.

System encyclopedia

What each roofing system is, how it performs, how it fails, and what to verify before specifying it.

  • EPDM Roofing Systems: A Complete Owner's Reference Editorially reviewed What EPDM rubber roofing is, how it performs over decades, realistic costs and service life, common failure modes, and what owners should verify before specifying it. · Updated Jul 15, 2026
  • TPO Roofing Systems: A Complete Owner's Reference Editorially reviewed What TPO is, how it performs, expected service life, common failure modes, and what building owners should verify before specifying it. · Updated Jul 1, 2026

Decision guides

Frameworks for the big decisions — what to weigh, what evidence to gather, and when each option deserves analysis.

  • Repair or Replace? How to Decide Editorially reviewed A structured decision framework for the most consequential commercial roofing decision — the evidence to gather, the tests to run, and the questions to ask before committing either way. · Updated Jul 1, 2026

Plain-English definitions of commercial roofing terms, written so a first-time building owner can follow a contractor proposal line by line.
